--The R. in कैलास: a branch of गङ्गा issuing out of the city of ब्रह्मा descends the southern slopes of Meru. Her course can be traced from the Gan- धमादन. Traversing the हेमकूट and Himalayas as also the continent of Bharata and dividing itself into seven branches it enters the sea on the south. A bath in this stream is equal to performing अश्वमेधस् and other sacri- fices. A महानदी: borne by शिव on his head for more than a hundred years: Elevated Sagara's sons to heaven. भा.
--a daughter of इरा, and mother of trees. Br.

--depend on वर्ण, स्थानयोग and नाट्य: Three places of origin--neck, head and mind: 4 वर्णस्, eight विकल्पस्, and sixteen deities: Different kinds of, described:
1: Br. III. ६
(I)--a pupil of दत्तात्रेय: a sage who realised the force of हरिमाया। भा.

(II)--a son of Dyumat, and father of Sannati. He retained his youth and ruled for ६६,000 years. The ब्र्। पुराण and the विष्णु पुराण make him the son respectively [page१-116+ २८] of Vatsa and Pratardana, and father of

A राजऋषि of काशी; attained longevity through the grace of लोपामुद्रा. Killed the राक्षस Ks2emaka and recovered his capital. Two ancient verses in his praise.
2: M. १८०. ६८-9; वा. ९२. ६६-8.
--the gourd-vessel of the नागस् to milk the earth cow. Br. II. ३६. २१३; M. १०. १९.

--a श्रुतऋषि: the chief author of the यजुर्वेद of the Eastern recension. Br. II. ३३. 6.
--a cruel राक्षस गण from आलम्बा. वा. ६९. १७२.
